attributes.description: EIH Associated Hotels Ltd is primarily engaged in owning premium luxury hotels under the luxury 'Oberoi' and five-star 'Trident' brands.[1] It is a Joint-Venture between the Oberoi Family and the Rajan Raheja Group.[2]
